args.title: Brightline Freight newsletter summary — freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
Combined summary of Brightline Freight's latest newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter ("Freight pricing this quarter"): introduces this week's topic of freight pricing and links to the full article on Brightline's blog (also promotes a webinar with a seat-hold link).

• Article (blog.brightline.example/2026/freight): spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.

• Companion piece (insights.brightline.example/freight/companion): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
